Echo Pulse Quirk.name: Echo Pulse Quirk
Echo Pulse Quirk.description:
🔊 Your voice carries a physical tremor into whatever it hits.

🧬 A Fusion Quirk of Sound and Vibration: about half a single Quirk's range and force, plus moves only the fusion can do.
🌱 At the start your shout rattles a target and your hum maps a room through a wall or smoke.
📈 With training: calls through rubble, a numbed limb, glass shattered or bolts loosened on one chosen object, a silenced area or a blocked sound Quirk, and foes dropped to their knees with nausea.
⚠️ Ear protection and soft materials blunt it.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Bodily Toll, as vibrating notes wear on your throat and inner ears.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Present Mic (Voice), Yo Shindo (Vibrate).

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Output +10, Quirk Analysis +10, Perception +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Rattle Call, Wall-Hum Echo
🛡️ Resists: sonic
Echo Pulse Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the voice sends tremor through air and solids; jaw and ears read echoes. New adult user: shouts rattle an adult a few meters off, crack glass up close; a hum maps a room through walls or smoke. More needs techniques. Limits: ear protection and soft materials blunt it; heavy use shakes their skull, dulls hearing, rasps the throat; din scrambles echoes. Quirk Strain: light: rattling shout, echo hum; moderate: bone-conducted call, numbing grasp, resonance hum; heavy: counter-tone, corridor chord; severe: signature nausea pulse, bracing drone. Fusion: Sound plus Vibration, each about half single-nature range and force; no kilometer shouts, sound leaps or fault quakes; only it echolocates, loosens bolts, resonance-shatters one object, cancels sound, counters sound Quirks, nauseates foes. Type: Emitter. Law: unlicensed nausea or shattering is assault and property damage; listening through private walls without cause is unlawful surveillance. Look: mouth ripple.
